title: Chapter 516
paragraphs: Chapter 516
Episode 142: Negotiations (2)
Joshua had fallen, but the ceremony to honor the Black Knight Jane was carried out solemnly.
The servants offered a moment of silence outside the tomb, holding flowers in their hands. The guardian knights held their swords upside down, forming a path towards the tomb.
Rosa held Jane's black helmet like a portrait, and Murakan stood beside her.
The Black Knight, the riders, the elders, the literary families, the guardian knights, and the nannies followed them. All were dressed in black mourning clothes.
As they passed through the courtyard full of swords, they reached the deepest part of the courtyard. The tomb had a strong smell of blood and iron even before the procession entered.
The flag of the Black Sword fluttered slowly in the cold wind of the tomb. The sound echoed through the stones inside, sounding like weeping, but no one was really crying.
Those who had the right to cry swallowed their tears, and those who didn't suppressed their emotions. Only the black helmet occasionally shone in the darkness.
This place was a special space reserved for those who had protected the family to the end.
For the Black Knights, the tomb could be considered the final destination of their pilgrimage. As long as they did not rebel, they were destined to be buried here.
The deeper they went into the tomb, the darker it became.
The procession gradually became smaller. At the entrance, the literary and housekeeping families stopped walking, and in the middle, the elders stood still.
In the end, only Rosa, the Black Knight, the riders, and Murakan remained in the procession. They could barely see each other's outlines.
With a clatter, Rosa placed Jane's helmet on the stone coffin in the middle.

"Even if the day comes when the stones of the Garden of Swords are completely destroyed, scattered by the wind, and the world forgets the name Runcandel, this loyalty and glory will never leave this place."
Murakan created a flower arrangement with the spirit and placed it in front of Jane's black helmet.
"Thank you, Jane."
The stone coffin closed, and the procession left the tomb a while later. On the way out, those who had been waiting outside rejoined the procession in reverse order.
When the procession finally left the tomb, the waiting knights raised mourning flags all over the Garden of Swords.
Thus, the ceremony to lay Jane's soul in the tomb, which lasted from early morning to noon, was over.
Originally, the tomb-laying process took over a week, but Rosa and the riders decided to proceed in a simplified manner considering various situations of the family.
The fact that the deceased's body was missing, that there had been a major battle recently, and that Joshua, the next head of the family, had been captured.
A heavier, more oppressive atmosphere than ever before flowed through the Garden of Swords.
"It's complicated..."
"Yeah."
Daytona and Heitona, the two stood under the eaves of the outer building to avoid the suddenly falling rain and smoked cigarettes.
Naturally, some of the riders gathered there. It wasn't just to avoid the rain or because of the Tona brothers.
Beyond the eaves, a woman was kneeling in front of Joshua's detached house.
She was Ilina Runcandel, who the brothers knew as Joshua's wife.
Joshua's wife, although having no real power and her position in the family being ambiguous, could not participate in the ceremony to honor Jane.
People thought the reason she came out and knelt outside the cell was not to honor Jane in this way, but to make a silent appeal for mercy for her husband.
"I understand her feelings, but it would have been better if she just stayed inside."
Ran shrugged as he spoke. Vigo nodded.
"There must be a reason why Mother left her like that. Leave her alone, she'll stop when she realizes it's no use and she might even die from it."
Diphus thought that the reason Rosa didn't stop her was ultimately to create a small justification for Joshua's return.
And the two who knew her true identity, Myu and Anne, had indifferent faces.
Jin focused more on Myu and Anne than on Ilina.
'The atmosphere has changed subtly...'
If it were the Myu and Anne he knew,
They should have been nervously revealing their uneasy looks. Because they wouldn't have the confidence that Joshua would be reinstated like himself and Diphus.
'Did Mother tell them that Joshua would be reinstated someday? No, Mother wouldn't need their help.'
It didn't seem like Myu and Anne had any hidden power or determination now, but somehow he didn't feel good about it.
'Is it just that they've made up their minds, or is there something else?'
It felt like he was looking at someone other than Myu and Anne.
"Ran, Vigo, brother. Let's talk."
"Us?"
"Yes."
"What's the topic?"
"Will it end like this? The lower knights should also band together to be responsible for one faction within the family. Otherwise, won't we be purged when someone takes the throne later?"
Myu spoke bluntly even though Jin and Diphus were listening.
"Myu, Anne. Who's going to kill you? Among the remaining higher knights, whoever takes the throne, it doesn't seem like that will happen."
"If the youngest takes the throne, I think our necks will be cut off that day, Brother Diphus."

"Ah, you might be killed by Mary if you keep acting badly towards her. The family is in this situation, and you're still only worried about personal survival? Do your part from where you are. When are you going to become human?"
At his words, Myu and Anne let out a bitter smile.
"...It seems like becoming human is no longer the right thing."
"Ran, Vigo, if you want to talk, come to our room anytime."
When Myu and Anne left, Petro came to find Jin.
"Young Master, the Acting Lord is looking for you."
Then Diphus nodded as if he had expected it.
"Take care, Jin."
"Yes, Brother."
The reason Jin and Diphus reacted like this was none other than that.
Some parts of the ship's blueprint and machinery obtained from the 2nd floor of the golden vault.
Jin had not yet handed them over to Rosa.
He followed Petro. Rosa was waiting for Jin in the central training ground. The training ground was still not fully restored after Jin's declaration as the head of the family.
On the way, the rain stopped.
"Have you arrived?"
"Yes, Acting Head."
For a moment, they looked at each other in silence.
"Last night, the Prophet sent me a message."
Instead of the blueprint and machinery, Rosa brought up the message first.
'A message? Wasn't Mother supposed to have direct communication with the Prophet?'

-Mother will never give up on the Prophet's power. Perhaps this time, bringing down Joshua could be a warning to the Prophet. If the relationship between Mother and the Prophet is not as close as with Joshua, it's entirely possible.
-So you're saying that Mother plans to bind the Prophet and turn everything around in the future, restoring Joshua to his position, right?
A conversation Jin had with Diphus not long ago.
As Jin had guessed at the time, Rosa was unable to communicate directly with the Prophet. She had never met the Prophet in person, nor did she know the identity of Ilina.
This was not due to Rosa's lack of ability. The Prophet's power was just that outstanding.
"What was the message?"
"It said that the Prophet can perfectly interpret and supplement the incomplete blueprint, and has a way to create a fleet."
Jin had not yet handed over the items, but he had informed Rosa that the blueprint was currently encrypted with a magic that Runcandel's technology could not decipher.
It was natural that the mass-produced ship blueprint could not be decrypted and copied by just anyone.
They could not even guess what the "machine" they had captured together was.
"Additionally, the Prophet claims to know the purpose of that machine. It's said to be an item that can change the course of the upcoming war..."
"Acting Head."
"Speak."
"Do you know what catalyst is used to implement the Prophet's power?"
"Living humans."
Rosa's answer contained no trace of guilt or shame.

"The infiltration route and tunnels you used in this mission, as well as the information related to the key to the 2nd floor and the tower, were all obtained by the Prophet using people as material. Prisoners from Ricarton were used."
The human tower that Dox witnessed in Ricarton.
The very materials used by the Prophet for Joshua's Sota Desert mission were those people.

"I sent one of the family's black knights to Ricarton. But even after the deadline passed, he did not return. When I went there myself, all that remained were the bones of tens of thousands of people, at the very least. There were probably innocent people's bones mixed in as well."
Jin had also sent Dox to that place and had not yet received any contact from him.
And it was the Black Knight sent by Rosa who saved Dox when he was in a life-threatening situation.
"Has the Black Knight still not returned?"
"That's right."
"Knowing that the prophet uses humans, why did you send the Black Knight to Ricalton? What were you trying to confirm? Did you rule out the possibility that the prophet could harm the Black Knight?"

"I have no reason to answer all your questions. That's not why I called you here. If you don't like my judgment and actions, you can just prove yourself by overcoming me. You're not being like yourself. If you feel disgusted by me, it's just proof that you're afraid of me."
She calmed her excitement.
As Rosa said, she was not in a position where she had to answer Jin's questions.
"Originally, I planned to use them through the prophet."
If Joshua had shown his awakening, Rosa would have handed over the blueprint and machine to the prophet without hesitation.
Although she did not completely trust the prophet, she was certain that all his actions were for the sake of "Joshua Runcandel."
Anyone who had directly encountered his absolute prophecy could not help but be certain of it.

"But this time, by suspending Joshua's knight qualification, I changed my mind. I will postpone negotiations with the prophet. In the meantime, prove to me that you have a better way than the prophet."
Hister.
And Hister's record magic.
As Joshua foresaw when the permanent mission to find 'Aria Owlhart' was assigned to the knights, Rosa already thought that Jin was in contact with the survivor of Hister.
If it's record magic, she judged that there would be a better way to use the items than the prophet's power.
That was the reason Rosa called Jin.
"If I fail, your acting lordship will... hand them over to the prophet. That's what you're saying."
"That's right."
"Even if I fail, they won't go to the prophet. Acting Lord."
"If you don't hand over the items to the family after failing, I will take them by force."

"What the family pursues is not tyranny or corruption. Affirming and using the prophet's power is a behavior that goes far beyond good. You speak as if you're bewitched by something, like some kind of curse."
"You must have felt a lot about the enemies in the Sota Desert, but you're talking out of complacency. Listen well, Jin Runcandel, my youngest son."
To me, the survival and prosperity of Runcandel is the most important value.
Nothing can surpass that value.

"Even if achieving that causes the death of billions of people, and the world eventually perishes in those devastated struggles and fights, and all that's left in it is just a few Runcandel members. It doesn't matter to me."
"Then, as always, my job will be to break you, Mother."
"Look forward to it."
Jin turned around and left the arena.
Rosa stood alone in the arena for a long time even after Jin had left.
